items.mainDefect: The catch block counts database update failures after successful Twilio scheduling as scheduling failures, leading to duplicate messages and deletion of reminders with live messages.

secondary.defect: Unrelated transient failures consume the retry budget and cause premature permanent deletion of reminders.
The retry-based deleteMany branch lacks an SMS method filter and can delete non-SMS reminders.
The retry-based deleteMany branch lacks a scheduled:false filter and can delete already-scheduled reminders.
